description: This file contains unit tests for the Controller component of the orchestrator package, specifically testing API endpoint handling, request processing, and integrations with various managers such as OperationManager and UserArtifactsManager. It verifies that HTTP requests are properly handled and returns expected status codes, covering multiple routes like /cvds, /cvds/{id}/logs, /operations, and user artifact endpoints.

classes.name: Controller
classes.description: Main controller struct responsible for handling HTTP routes related to CVDs, operations, user artifacts, and debug endpoints within the orchestrator package.

methods.name: AddRoutes
methods.description: Method that registers HTTP route handlers to the given router for the Controller.
